items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) ruled OUT, will not travel to London for Week 6 vs Jaguars. Woody Marks expected to handle full RB workload.
items.why: Missed practices; no travel decision finalized Thursday.
items.implication: Marks inherits near-100% snaps/touches as seen last week post-Montgomery exit.
items.opportunity: Full RB snaps, carries, red-zone for Marks; Dell absence opens WR targets elsewhere in HOU.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers (and indefinitely) due to movement in superficial blood clot in calf from prior cleat injury; Tanner McKee to start. Full medical timeline detailed by team.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound showed clot movement; health priority, treatment course TBD.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense volatility; Hurts managers scramble for streamers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/role for remaining pass-catchers like Goedert if healthy; McKee streaming upside in favorable spot.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return in TNF vs SEA due to shoulder, then returned to the game and was ACTIVE.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.
items.opportunity: Maintains WR role/snaps/targets in DEN offense.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle WR28 on usage/volume concerns independent of status.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore DNP for second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of OUT/Q for Week 6; monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: If OUT, boost to other BUF pass-catchers targets/routes.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Questionable/OUT risk; impacts ARI backfield depth/role.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more carries/snaps to other ARI RBs.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Availability in doubt for Week 6; KC WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, more routes/targets to Worthy/others.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant again Thursday; working back from hamstring, return trending positive but needs more clearance tests.
items.implication: Likely ACTIVE/return imminent for Week 6; boosts CHI offense.
items.opportunity: Full snaps if cleared; unlocks WR/TE usage (Odunze, Burden, Loveland).

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz etc.). Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Better risk moving year early than late.
items.why: Age curve + Eagles precedent; opportunity/role focus over production.
items.implication: Sell-high/trade candidate ROS if contending teams inquire; dynasty/redraft value shift.
items.opportunity: Potential new team/role expansion elsewhere; current PHI depth concerns amplify.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4 this week. Commanders defense buffet for pass-catchers; Evans season-high target share recently, even higher without Deebo. ALL IN.
items.why: Soft matchup + elevated usage/target share (36% W5, 45%+ w/o Deebo); Deebo multi-week out.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, red-zone in favorable spot; depth thin behind.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week OUT high ankle; Rhamondre Stevenson borderline RB1/ volume monster (85% snaps/23 touches prior similar absence). LOVE Stevenson vs NYJ RB9. Also LOVE Kyren Williams RB5, Javonte Williams RB8 on volume + soft run Ds.
items.why: Henderson multi-week; Stevenson historical volume when featured; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line.
items.implication: Start Stevenson confidently; Kyren/Javonte locked RB2+.
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps/third-down for Stevenson; goal-line/red-zone Javonte; Kyren workhorse.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) DNP Thursday (and prior); listed toward questionable, hopeful but uncertain for Week 6 vs CAR. Depth thin with others hurt.
items.why: Hamstring from earlier; no practice ramp yet.
items.implication: High OUT risk; if plays limited role possible.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Dameon Pierce/Carson Steele/handcuffs get carries/goal-line; reverse if IN.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty says he is feeling great, best he has felt this season; positive update.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, receiving work secured in LV backfield.

items.text: 49ers opened practice window for WR Christian Kirk (calf, IR all season).
items.implication: Potential activation soon; depth for SF WRs.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets competition if activated; monitor for role.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle WR28 (volume collapse outside one game), Emeka Egbuka WR34, Kyle Pitts TE18, Woody Marks RB22, JK Dobbins RB27, Bo Nix QB23, Justin Herbert QB25. Soft reasons: matchups, QB play, role/volume issues.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA for Waddle/Nix/Dobbins), shaky QB/usage (Egbuka/Pitts), tough run D + role (Marks), low totals (Herbert).
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats; pivot to loves.
items.conflict: Waddle status ACTIVE but usage concerns dominate for Berry.
